summary.text: Leslie Jones is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 130, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A board-certified music therapist who has run her own therapy business and taught as an adjunct professor at Drury University, Jones also ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Leslie Jones was born in Springfield, Missouri, and graduated from Springfield Catholic High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Drury University in 2008 and a graduate degree from Drury in 2012.
Her career has been as a board-certified music therapist, and as of 2024 she was affiliated with the American Music Therapy Association.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Jones said she has run Musical Bridges Music Therapy for more than 12 years and has been an adjunct music therapy professor at Drury University since 2012.
Bishop Davidson defeated Jones in the November 5, 2024 general election for Missouri House District 130.
In the same 2024 survey, Jones said she was a team lead for her local Moms Demand Action chapter before running for office and is the mother of two young children.
She listed public education, affordable childcare, fair wages, healthcare access and affordability, reproductive rights, public safety and infrastructure among her priorities.
